δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
ζώειν: ζώω — live; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῆν)
θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
θεοπροπίης: θεοπροπίη — a prophetic utterance, oracle; fem. gen. sg.
κατερύκει: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. 3 sg.
κεκλίαται: κλίνω — lean, lie; perf. pass.-in-form 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic κέκλινται): ’lie’ (of islands lying on the sea)
λάβοι: λαμβάνω — take, catch; aor. opt. 3 sg. act.: ’he might catch’ (after εἴ, ’in case’)
μύθου: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. gen. sg.
πέτραι: πέτρα — rock, crag, cliff; fem. nom. pl.
ποτιδέρκεται: ποτιδέρκομαι — look at, gaze at; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic ποτι- (= πρός)
προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
τούς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also with a noun, article-like: ’the, those’ (τούς τ’ ἄλλους ’and the others’)
φέρτατ: φέρτατος — best, mightiest; superl., masc. voc. sg., elided φέρτατ’ (= φέρτατε), with gen. Ἀχαιῶν
φυλάσσεις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; pres. 2 sg.
ἀμήχανος: ἀμήχανος — without resource, helpless, unmanageable; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adjective): ’helpless’
ἀμφιβέβηκε: ἀμφιβαίνω — go around, enfold, envelop; perf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’has wrapped around’
ἀνελέσθαι: ἀναιρέω — take up, win (a prize); aor. inf. mid.: ’to take up, win’
ἐλάσας: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck’ (with a blow of the hand)
ἐμπάζομαι: ἐμπάζομαι — take heed of, pay attention to (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg.
ἔφην: φημί — say, declare; impf. 1 sg., augmented, ἐ- before the consonant-initial stem φη-: ’I said’ · also ’I thought, supposed’, + fut. inf. (ἔφην ἔσσεσθαι ’I supposed he would be’)
ἠλίβατοι: ἠλίβατος — steep, towering (sense uncertain; ’steep’ is the traditional guess); adj., fem. nom. pl.
ὀλίγην: ὀλίγος — little, small, scanty; fem. acc. sg.
ὀλοφύρεαι: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, bewail; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic -ῃ)
ὑπερβασίης: ὑπερβασίη — transgression, outrage, overstepping of bounds; fem. gen. sg., genitive of the charge with τίνομαι: ’for their transgression’
